entries.title: Psalms 73:1
segments: ¶Truly, God is good to Israel, even to such as are clean in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 73:2
segments: But as for me, my feet had almost gone from under me; I was near to slipping;

entries.title: Psalms 73:3
segments: Because of my envy of the men of pride, when I saw the well-being of the wrongdoers.

entries.title: Psalms 73:4
segments: For they have no pain; their bodies are fat and strong.

entries.title: Psalms 73:5
segments: They are not in trouble as others are; they have no part in the unhappy fate of men.

entries.title: Psalms 73:6
segments: For this reason pride is round them like a chain; they are clothed with violent behaviour as with a robe.

entries.title: Psalms 73:7
segments: Their eyes are bursting with fat; they have more than their heart's desire.

entries.title: Psalms 73:8
segments: Their thoughts are deep with evil designs; their talk from their seats of power is of cruel acts.

entries.title: Psalms 73:9
segments: Their mouth goes up to heaven; their tongues go walking through the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 73:10
segments: For this reason they are full of bread; and water is ever flowing for them.

entries.title: Psalms 73:11
segments: And they say, How will the Lord see this? is there knowledge in the Most High?

entries.title: Psalms 73:12
segments: Truly, such are the sinners; they do well at all times, and their wealth is increased.

entries.title: Psalms 73:13
segments: As for me, I have made my heart clean to no purpose, washing my hands in righteousness;

entries.title: Psalms 73:14
segments: For I have been troubled all the day; every morning have I undergone punishment.

entries.title: Psalms 73:15
segments: ¶If I would make clear what it is like, I would say, You are false to the generation of your children.

entries.title: Psalms 73:16
segments: When my thoughts were turned to see the reason of this, it was a weariness in my eyes;

entries.title: Psalms 73:17
segments: Till I went into God's holy place, and saw the end of the evil-doers.

entries.title: Psalms 73:18
segments: You put their feet where there was danger of slipping, so that they go down into destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 73:19
segments: How suddenly are they wasted! fears are the cause of their destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 73:20
segments: As a dream when one is awake, they are ended; they are like an image gone out of mind when sleep is over.

entries.title: Psalms 73:21
segments: ¶My heart was made bitter, and I was pained by the bite of grief:

entries.title: Psalms 73:22
segments: As for me, I was foolish, and without knowledge; I was like a beast before you.

entries.title: Psalms 73:23
segments: But still I am ever with you; you have taken me by my right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 73:24
segments: Your wisdom will be my guide, and later you will put me in a place of honour.

entries.title: Psalms 73:25
segments: Whom have I in heaven but you? and having you I have no desire for anything on earth.

entries.title: Psalms 73:26
segments: My flesh and my heart are wasting away: but God is the Rock of my heart and my eternal heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 73:27
segments: For those who are far away from you will come to destruction: you will put an end to all those who have not kept faith with you.

entries.title: Psalms 73:28
segments: But it is good for me to come near to God: I have put my faith in the Lord God, so that I may make clear all his works.
